rules.anchor_definition: Last PLC command whose corresponding tracking obligation was qualified and successfully resolved; never alias immediately previous PLC command.
rules.initialization: At first valid released measurement, if first observed PLC command is already within frozen tracking tolerance of released speed and no unresolved obligation exists, establish a directly observed qualified steady baseline; otherwise leave anchor absent and retain R5.2.1R startup behavior. Never infer historical PLC command from open-loop preparation speed.
rules.advancement: Advance only on valid STEADY_TRACKING after qualified progress and successful epoch resolution; record prior/new value, epoch id, timestamp and reason. No advance on issued command, partial progress, timer, reversal or invalid sample.
rules.net_demand: current_plc_command - qualified_command_anchor; signed net displacement; never sum absolute path length.
rules.observable_cumulative: When anchor exists and no active unresolved epoch, classify current net magnitude with frozen material_command_delta and profile-derived response observability. Trigger at first qualifying command timestamp, not prior subthreshold timestamps.
rules.active_epoch: Keep qualified command anchor fixed. Same-direction updates retain epoch/watch age and suspicion and update latest command/envelope. Updated opportunity cannot be later than an already-open opportunity.
rules.cancellation_before_epoch: Net demand returning to anchor before qualification creates no epoch, no watch and no fault evidence.
rules.return_after_epoch: Never erase epoch/watch/valid deficit solely on command return; preserve existing unresolved-motion and reversal semantics.
rules.reversal: On material reversal close/reanchor directional epoch; unresolved watch carries age and evidence if qualified motion absent. Anchor never jumps to reversal command.
rules.sensor_invalid: Display INSUFFICIENT_MEASUREMENT, retain anchor and unresolved demand; invalid samples provide no motion or confirm evidence. On first valid recovery evaluate preserved causal context without new grace.
rules.progress_suspect_confirm_recovery: Exactly frozen R5.2.1R rules and R5.2 numerical parameters; no new threshold/timer or top-level Safety reset authority.
